_about: A kit sheet for the formula estimate (math-fallback P2, `app/formula/genshin/sheets.py`). Structure (which number buffs what, for whom, under which condition) is transcribed from Genshin Optimizer's character sheets at `go_commit` (MIT), cited per effect to `pando:`/`wr:` file:lines under the `go` roots, and to gcsim's Go at `gcsim_commit` where gcsim implements the same buff. No number is written here: every value is a reference into the seeded catalogue (a talent row by label, a constellation or passive param_list by index), pinned under `pins` so a re-seed that changes one withholds the effect rather than misreading it.

conditions.label: Debate stacks: Chisel-Light Mirrors he generated in the last 8 seconds (C2)
Chisel-Light Mirrors his burst consumed (C4): Elemental Mastery to the others per mirror consumed; Dendro DMG to him per mirror it then generates (3 minus those consumed, 3 at C6)
A mirror was generated beyond the maximum of three (C6)

effects.label: A4 Mysteries Laid Bare: Projection Attack DMG per point of his EM, capped
A4 Mysteries Laid Bare: Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena DMG per point of his EM, capped
C2 Debate: Elemental Mastery per stack
C4 Elucidation: Elemental Mastery to the other party members per mirror consumed
C4 Elucidation: Dendro DMG per mirror generated (the second of two at one consumed)
C4 Elucidation: Dendro DMG per mirror generated (the first, at one or two consumed)
C4 Elucidation at C6 Structuration: Dendro DMG per mirror generated, three generated (mirror 1 of 3)
C4 Elucidation at C6 Structuration: Dendro DMG per mirror generated, three generated (mirror 2 of 3)
C4 Elucidation at C6 Structuration: Dendro DMG per mirror generated, three generated (mirror 3 of 3)
C6 Structuration: CRIT Rate after an excess mirror
C6 Structuration: CRIT DMG after an excess mirror

unmodelled.what: Universality: An Elaboration on Form: Dendro infusion of his Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks while he holds a mirror
unmodelled.reason: an infusion changes a hit's element, which the estimate does not model (G4); a row's own channel can be set to Dendro

unmodelled.what: Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena: attack instances by mirrors held
unmodelled.reason: a count of hits, which is the row's count, not a buff

unmodelled.what: Four-Causal Correction: a mirror from Charged and Plunging Attacks
unmodelled.reason: no damage effect: it generates mirrors (their buffs are C2's, C4's, C6's conditions)

unmodelled.what: Intuition: skill cooldown reduced by Projection Attacks
Structuration: the burst keeps his mirrors at three
unmodelled.reason: no damage effect itself: its effect on C4's Dendro DMG (three generated) is applied

unmodelled.what: Mirrors consumed at 0 on C6 (GO's WR reading: three generated)
unmodelled.reason: GO's pando port itself loses this state, gating on one or more consumed (pando:Alhaitham.ts:131-132); followed as written
